behaviors.description: Read an exported file through the sandbox's document grant.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private document portal, FUSE, installed fixture app and host file outside sandbox access.
behaviors.expected: Direct host read fails; document-path read returns exact content; default grant denies writes and preserves origin.

behaviors.description: Grant and revoke sandbox document write access.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real document portal and sandbox app with a readable export.
behaviors.expected: Write grant changes origin; revocation denies subsequent writes while reads and previous content survive.

behaviors.description: Create an independent document ID for an already exported file.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real document portal with one existing export.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary export reuses the ID; unique export has a distinct ID and independent grants; removing it preserves original export.

behaviors.description: Round-trip each document permission through allow and forbid options.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real document portal with a read-only export.
behaviors.expected: Public portal Info reports exact permissions after each grant/revoke and after granting two app IDs together.

behaviors.description: Export a path before its file exists.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real document portal and absent file in an existing directory.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary export fails; noexist returns a grant without creating origin; later content is readable through that grant.

behaviors.description: Compare transient and persistent exports across portal restart.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real document portal with one persistent export and one transient export.
behaviors.expected: Both exports exist before restart; only persistent ID, content and permissions remain afterward.

mappings.rationale: Sandbox reads exact exported content despite denied original path and cannot write through the default read grant.

surface_assertions.rationale: The named sandbox app receives a readable grant while direct host access remains denied.

mappings.rationale: A successful sandbox write proves the grant works; after revocation probe-level denial and unchanged origin prove write protection while reads still succeed.

surface_assertions.rationale: Sandbox writes through the grant and changes the original file.
Previously permitted sandbox writes fail after revocation and leave origin content intact.

mappings.rationale: Ordinary repeated export preserves ID; unique export differs and can be independently unexported.

surface_assertions.rationale: Distinct document IDs and independent per-app grants contrast with ordinary ID reuse.

mappings.rationale: Independent public portal Info checks exact per-app permission sets after each allow/forbid operation.

surface_assertions.rationale: Public Info reports no remaining grant after read revocation.
Public Info adds delete to the app's permissions.
Public Info removes a previously granted delete permission.
Public Info adds grant-permissions to the app's permissions.
Public Info removes a previously granted grant-permissions permission.

mappings.rationale: Nonexistent-path rejection contrasts with a noexist grant that resolves independently created content.

surface_assertions.rationale: Absent-file export succeeds only with noexist, does not create origin, and exposes subsequently written content.

mappings.rationale: Restart removes transient ID while retaining persistent ID, permissions and content.

surface_assertions.rationale: A persistent control survives the same portal restart that removes the transient export.

notes: Real permission-store and document-portal processes run on the private case bus with isolated XDG directories. FUSE mounts are unmounted and checked during cleanup.
